releases.body:
Dependency-free runtime, pnpm tooling, and CLI install docs.

- Install with `opencode plugin add opencode-firefox`
- Clean installs pull only the plugin (no runtime dependencies)
- Repo moved to pnpm; CI runs typecheck + tests
- Deprecated the `0.0.0-stage` staged-publish placeholder

Full diff: https://github.com/rimar/opencode-firefox/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
